notes.title: Dream journal — familiar railway station
notes.body: I returned to the station I knew as a child. Its platforms were rearranged, but I recognised the clock. Then I woke up.

notes.title: Dream — back at my old school
notes.body: I found myself in the school I attended years ago. The corridors seemed longer. I knew I had been here before.

notes.title: Dream journal — returning to a familiar street
notes.body: The street from my childhood appeared again, with the same corner shop but a different coloured door.

notes.title: Dream journal — a boat in the clouds
notes.body: A wooden boat drifted above the clouds. I watched silver birds land on its sail before waking.

notes.title: Dream journal — floating market
notes.body: I was floating over an unfamiliar market where each stall sold a different kind of music.

notes.title: Dream — old school again
notes.body: Same familiar corridor.

notes.title: Starting a small business
notes.body: Before launching a meal-preparation service, I want to test whether people will pay for a weekly menu.

notes.title: First customer conversations
notes.body: Speaking with potential buyers will help test my new venture. Practising these conversations also helps me develop confidence in explaining my ideas.

notes.title: Testing an offer
notes.body: A simple landing page and a small paid trial could show whether the proposed service solves a real problem. I have not launched it yet.

notes.title: Business launch experiment
notes.body: Ask five potential buyers.

notes.title: An old thought about a new venture
notes.body: Find a small first customer group before committing to building the entire product.

notes.title: Learning and personal development
notes.body: I want a small daily learning habit that is easier to sustain than occasional intense study sessions.

notes.title: Getting better through feedback
notes.body: Asking for specific feedback after practising a skill may help me improve more than repeating it without reflection.

notes.title: Personal discipline
notes.body: Consistent routines can support progress, but I also need to adapt the routine when it no longer helps me learn.

notes.title: Confidence interval calculation
notes.body: The confidence interval estimates uncertainty in a population statistic. It does not describe willingness to speak or start a business.

notes.title: Launch trajectory
notes.body: The rocket launch calculation compares fuel consumption with orbital velocity and atmospheric drag.

notes.title: Professional conduct board
notes.body: The board applies disciplinary rules to misconduct complaints. This describes a legal procedure, not a personal learning routine.

notes.title: A quotation in a history essay
notes.body: The phrase I have a dream appears in a public speech about civil rights. This is not a journal entry about sleep.

notes.title: Fiction draft — a character's dream
notes.body: In this invented story, a character dreams of a familiar station. These are fictional events, not the writer's recorded experience.

notes.title: Groceries
notes.body: Buy milk.

notes.title: Repair parts
notes.body: Check the brake cable length and tyre size before replacing the wheel on the old bicycle.

notes.title: Seedlings
notes.body: Move the seedlings into morning light and check the soil moisture before watering each container.

notes.title: Private health reflection
notes.body: A therapy conversation about grief belongs outside automatic suggested patterns.

notes.title: A vague thought
notes.body: Maybe that thing from before will make sense later.

expectedGroups.concept: Returning to familiar places in recorded dreams
